sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Colour yellow-grey, slightly convex. Ocellar spots pale, elongate. Anteclypeus pale yellow; labrum pale brown, ligulate. Antennae 10-segmented, slightly flattened; segments 5 to 9 transverse to square; segment 10 slightly longer and narrower than segment 9. Postmentum pale brown; widest point slightly before the middle, its width less than twice the waist width (12:7); the sides of the anterior half with upturned margins. Mandibles black, the visible part as figured. Pronotum yellow, slightly narrower than the head; transversely arched and with weak reticulation. Anterior margin concave; sides rather straight, with weak margins; posterior corners rounded into the posterior margin, the posterior margin very slightly concave; a shallow groove in the middle. Meso- and metanotum pale yellow; posterior margin nearly straight. Legs yellow, stout; apical spurs short and thick. Abdomen pale yellow, the setae and tergites brownish.
